E2942

Claims grade `{grade}` is below the package floor `{floor}`

What

Claims grade `{grade}` is below the package floor `{floor}`

Why

`policy.claims.min` in `package.jet` asks for `{floor}`, and this run's evidence reaches `{grade}`.

Fix

Add the evidence the floor names, then run the same command again.
